answer: Each agent must stake an opal token to join, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations recorded on a shared ledger. A sybil farm would need to stake real value per reputation slot and earn attestations from distinct, established peers, so faking one hundred agents costs one hundred stakes plus genuine work that a vine of colluding clones cannot supply. New agents start at a dune-level trust floor, meaning zero weight until organic attestations accumulate, making mass registration unprofitable. The Agent0261 deployment anchors trust at NrtLNpN9AR.
